summary: Verification pass on deployed NovaBet (Railway). Backend API: 18/18 tests pass. Frontend: lobby, auth (demo + admin), slots spin, roulette spin, blackjack & crash UIs, wallet deposit/withdraw modal, SPA deep-route fallback, mobile 390px, and all /img/*.webp assets all work on the public URLs. No critical issues. Two minor observations noted.

minor.issue: Returns 401 on initial page load before login (expected, but surfaces as a console error on the lobby); consider silencing in client or returning 200 with null user

integration_issues.issue: Admin login (admin@novabet.demo) succeeds and shows 'Welcome back, Admin' toast, but the app exposes no visible admin-only UI. Clicking user-menu-trigger reveals no admin links, and visiting /admin loads the SPA shell with an empty content area (header + footer only, no admin panel component). If an admin view is intended, it is not wired up. If not intended, this is just a note.

issues: Console shows 'PAGEERROR: Unexpected token <' on every page load — a JS/asset request is being resolved by the SPA fallback returning index.html instead of a 404, so the browser tries to parse HTML as JS. Not blocking but should be traced (likely a missing source-map or a stale chunk reference). Does not affect functionality.

action_items: (Optional) Decide whether NovaBet should expose an admin dashboard. If yes, implement an /admin route and conditional admin menu items based on the logged-in user's role.
(Optional) Investigate the 'Unexpected token <' pageerror — likely a stale JS chunk URL in index.html or a sourcemap request falling through the SPA fallback.
critical_code_review_comments: Not applicable — this was a black-box verification of a deployed third-party app; source lives in the user's Emergent workspace, not in /app.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of in-scope flows (lobby, demo login, admin login, slots spin, roulette spin, blackjack UI, crash UI, deposit modal, mobile, SPA deep route)

test_credentials: Demo: demo@novabet.demo / demo1234 (balance seeded 1000). Admin: admin@novabet.demo / Admin@123. Both working.
seed_data_creation: None. Demo user and admin are seeded automatically on API startup. Note: demo balance started at 1000, dropped to 985 after prior test runs, then kept moving (980 after slot spin, 925→930 after roulette). This is expected play-money behavior; a reset endpoint would be nice for repeated test runs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: NovaBet is deployed and working end to end on Railway (web: novabet-web-production, api: novabet-api-production). Backend contract: wallet deposit/withdraw REQUIRE a 'method' field (card/crypto/bank/ewallet) in addition to amount. Roulette expects {bets:[{type:'red'|'black'|'odd'|'even'|'straight'|'low'|'high'|'dozen'|'column', amount:N}]} — 'color' is not a valid type. All 8 /img/*.webp assets return 200. SPA fallback is correctly configured. Demo balance persists across sessions, so if you need a clean 1000 balance either re-run the seed or just account for drift.
rca of the issue: No issues to RCA. Everything in the requested test matrix works. The two minor notes above are informational, not failures.
